notes.title: PoseViewer 3.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Engine Upgrade! Better Look overall, lighting & reflections, Materials & Performance
[*] New and improved Cumshot system
[*] New Poses! 79 Poses in total
[*] More Climaxes! 26 Climaxes in total
[*] New Mountain Environment
[*] Added Guy + "Hide Male" Filter option, for the easily scared
[*] Added over 200 Voice Overs for each Character
[*] Photo mode for stunning Photos with tons of settings & filters
[*] Added a full collection of Hats to Customization

[/list]
